name: Furukawa Electric Co., Ltd.
blurb: Furukawa Electric is a Japanese industrial conglomerate founded in 1884, with four segments: Infrastructure (optical fiber, power cable), Electrical and Electronic (connectors, PCB materials), Functional Products (heat pipes, automotive components), and Services. Its optical-communications operations were unified in 2025 under the Lightera brand, which in March 2026 began mass production of 13,824-count fiber cable — among the densest in the world — for hyperscale data centers. Lightera also supplies fusion splicers and field-installable connectors used throughout fiber-optic network deployment.
recent: Furukawa Electric reached an all-time high of JPY 47,940 on April 14, 2026, before pulling back to roughly JPY 41,190 by early May. The stock had outperformed the Nikkei 225 by approximately 193% over the prior six months. Market capitalization reached JPY 2.9 trillion (up ~995% year-on-year). Q3 FY2025 earnings of JPY 320 per share beat consensus estimates by more than 110%. Buy ratings from Goldman Sachs, Nomura, and Morgan Stanley were in place heading into spring 2026. Revenue for the trailing twelve months stood at JPY 1.27 trillion; the company's next earnings date is May 12, 2026.
